title: Senior Software Engineer, DevOps
description:
Muck Rack is the leading SaaS platform for public relations and communications professionals. Our mission is to enable organizations to build trust, tell their stories, and demonstrate the unique value of earned media. Muck Rack’s AI-powered, comprehensive, and integrated platform streamlines the PR workflow to help businesses generate positive media coverage, monitor mentions to manage brand reputation, and analyze PR’s impact on business outcomes. By combining media database, monitoring, and reporting into one dynamic platform, we empower teams to collaborate seamlessly, pitch effectively, and analyze results faster and more efficiently.

Founder-controlled, fully distributed, and growing sustainably, Muck Rack has received several awards for its unparalleled culture and product from organizations like Inc., Quartz, G2, and BuiltIn. We value resilience, transparency, ownership, and customer devotion, and infuse these values into everything we do. 

We’re looking for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps team.

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll help enable the broader engineering organization to do high-impact work by building and improving the infrastructure, tooling, and deployment systems they rely on every day. You’ll contribute to the development of standardized infrastructure and “paved paths” that make it easier to provision, deploy, and operate services reliably at scale.

You’ll collaborate closely with application engineering teams to ensure our container-based infrastructure is scalable, cost-efficient, and dependable across a wide range of workloads.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with DevOps and application engineering teams to design and improve standardized infrastructure, deployment workflows, and CI/CD pipelines

title: Principal Innovation Business Analyst
description:
Due to Precision's continual growth, we are looking for a Principal Innovation Business Analyst to join our European team. The position can be covered fully remotely from the UK.

Position Summary:

The Principal Innovation Business Analyst serves as a bridge between business stakeholders, clinical teams, Innovation, and technology partners to identify opportunities for process improvement and support the implementation and adoption of AI-enabled solutions. This role combines clinical research knowledge with strong business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and change management skills. The successful candidate will work with business teams to understand workflows and challenges, gather and document requirements, support implementation activities, coordinate testing and user feedback, and help drive adoption of new technologies, including Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled solutions. The Principal Innovation Business Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure solutions are aligned with business needs and supported by effective documentation, training, governance, and change management practices. This role will also support the development and deployment of AI agents, prompt libraries, SOPs, work instructions, and other resources that help teams effectively leverage emerging technologies

Main Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ensures system adoption through training, communication, hands-on demonstrations and stakeholder engagement. Escalates concerns to leadership when additional intervention is required.
  • Leads or supports system implementation, including testing, training and supporting existing and new systems.
  • Understand the needs and pain points of the Business Operation Systems. Uses this knowledge to provide advice, guidance and remove barriers.

title: Managing Director, UK
description:
Location : United Kingdom
 Type: Full-time | Hybrid-flexible | Based near one of our portfolio company locations
 Note : This is an ongoing opportunity for future Managing Directors across the Everfield ecosystem. As we continue to grow our portfolio, we are proactively engaging with candidates who have the leadership experience and operational expertise to step into Managing Director roles within our vertical market software companies.
 About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.
Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices while focusing on what they do best—building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics.
Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 7 countries—and growing.
 The Role As Managing Director (MD), you will lead one of Everfield’s portfolio companies and assume full ownership of its strategy, execution, and performance. This role is designed for operationally strong leaders with deep experience in software businesses who are ready to take end-to-end responsibility for a growing company.
You will work closely with Everfield’s central teams but operate independently, with the autonomy to shape the future of the business. This role is especially suited to individuals with prior experience running software companies in a standalone or platform model, particularly in the €2M–€10M recurring revenue range.
